name: @jasonbelmonti/markdown-engine
description: Deterministic Markdown parsing and validation engine package.

scripts.release:verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && npm run docs:rich-ir-contract && npm run docs:declarative-validation-contract && npm run audit:declarative-validation-boundary && npm run build && npm run build:cli:bundled && npm run release:verify:installer-pin && node scripts/prove-repeatability.mjs --runs 10 && npm run release:check-clean
scripts.snapshots:update:parser: npm run build && vitest run tests/parser-fixtures.test.ts -u "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.snapshots:update:rules: npm run build && vitest run tests/rules.test.ts -u "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.snapshots:update:rich-ir: npm run build && vitest run tests/rich-ir-targets.test.ts tests/rich-ir-queries.test.ts tests/rich-ir-link-references.test.ts -u "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.snapshots:update:serialization: npm run build && vitest run tests/serialization-repeatability.test.ts tests/boundary-inspection.test.ts -u "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:rich-ir:proving: npm run build && vitest run tests/rich-ir-proving.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:rich-ir:contract: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.document-contract.json && vitest run tests/document-contract.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:rich-ir:targets: npm run build && vitest run tests/rich-ir-targets.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:rich-ir:queries: npm run build && vitest run tests/rich-ir-queries.test.ts tests/rich-ir-link-references.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:rich-ir:annotations: npm run build && vitest run tests/rich-ir-annotations.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:rich-ir:compat: npm run build && vitest run tests/rich-ir-compat.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:rich-ir:repeatability: npm run build && vitest run tests/rich-ir-repeatability.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:rich-ir:downstream: npm run build && vitest run tests/rich-ir-downstream.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:validation:contract: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.declarative-validation-contract.json && vitest run tests/declarative-validation-contract.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:validation:cli: npm run build && vitest run tests/declarative-validation-cli.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:validation:repeatability: npm run build && vitest run tests/declarative-validation-repeatability.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**" && node scripts/prove-declarative-validation-repeatability.mjs --runs 10
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run build:cli:bundled && vitest run --coverage "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
scripts.test:snapshots: npm run build && vitest run tests/parser-fixtures.test.ts tests/rules.test.ts tests/rich-ir-targets.test.ts tests/rich-ir-queries.test.ts tests/rich-ir-link-references.test.ts tests/serialization-repeatability.test.ts "--exclude=.worktrees/**"
